books.intro: Sahih al-Bukhari ni icykusanyo cy'hadithi cyakusanyijwe na Imam Muhammad al-Bukhari (yapfuye mu 256 AH/870 CE) (rahimahullah). Icyo cykusanyo cye gihabwa agaciro n'ubwiganze bukabije bw'isi y'Abayisilamu nka cyo cykusanyo cya mbere cy'ukuri ku nkuru z'Imigirire y'Intumwa Muhammad (ﷺ). Kirimo hadithi zirenga 7500 (hamwe n'izisubiramo) mu bitabo 97. Ubuhinduzi butanzwe hano ni ubwa Dr. M. Muhsin Khan.

Sahih Muslim ni icykusanyo cy'hadithi cyakusanyijwe na Imam Muslim ibn al-Hajjaj al-Naysaburi (rahimahullah). Icykusanyo cye kifatwa nka rimwe mu makusanyirizo y'ukuri cyane y'Sunnah y'Intumwa (ﷺ), kandi hamwe na Sahih al-Bukhari igakora "Sahihain," cyangwa "Sahih Zibiri." Kirimo hadithi perezida 7500 (hamwe n'izisubiramo) mu bitabo 57. Ubuhinduzi butanzwe hano ni ubwa Abdul Hamid Siddiqui.

Sunan an-Nasa'i ni icykusanyo cy'hadithi cyakusanyijwe na Imam Ahmad an-Nasa'i (rahimahullah). Icykusanyo cye ku bwumvikane busesuye kifatwa nka rimwe mu bitabo batandatu by'ibanze by'hadithi (Kutub as-Sittah) by'Sunnah y'Intumwa (ﷺ). Kirimo hadithi perezida 5700 (hamwe n'izisubiramo) mu bitabo 52.

Jami` at-Tirmidhi ni icykusanyo cy'hadithi cyakusanyijwe na Imam Abu `Isa Muhammad at-Tirmidhi (rahimahullah). Icykusanyo cye ku bwumvikane busesuye kifatwa nka rimwe mu bitabo batandatu by'ibanze by'hadithi (Kutub as-Sittah) by'Sunnah y'Intumwa (ﷺ). Kirimo hadithi perezida 4400 (hamwe n'izisubiramo) mu bitabo 46.

Sunan Ibn Majah ni icykusanyo cy'hadithi cyakusanyijwe na Imam Muhammad bin Yazid Ibn Majah al-Qazvini (rahimahullah). Kifatwa cyane nka gaturatu ka gatandatu mu bitabo batandatu by'ibanze by'hadithi (Kutub as-Sittah) by'Sunnah y'Intumwa (ﷺ). Gikubiyemo hadithi 4341 mu bitabo 37.

Al-Muwatta (mu buryo bw'ijambo bivuze "inzira yakandagiwe" cyangwa "ibyakorohejwe") cyakusanyijwe na Imam Malik ibn Anas mu kinyejana cya 8, ni icykusanyo kimwe mu bya kera cyane kandi gifite ububasha bw'imigirire ya Gisilamu n'amategeko (fiqh). Gihuza mu buryo bw'umwihariko hadithi z'Intumwa (marfu) hamwe n'izimanza, imigirire n'amagambo by'Abasangirangendo (mawquf) n'Abayikurikiye (maqtu), gitsindagirira cyane imigirire y'amategeko n'ubwumvikane bw'abaturage b'i Madina.

Sunan Abi Dawud ni icykusanyo cy'hadithi cyakusanyijwe na Imam Abu Dawud Sulayman ibn al-Ash'ath as-Sijistani (rahimahullah). Kifatwa cyane nka kimwe mu bitabo batandatu by'ibanze by'hadithi (Kutub as-Sittah) by'Sunnah y'Intumwa (ﷺ). Gikubiyemo hadithi 5274 mu bitabo 43. Harimo n'ibaruwa ya Imam Abu Dawud yandikiye abantu b'i Makkah asobanura igitabo cye, amagambo yakoresheje n'uburyo bwe.
